annotations.title: JSON toolbox: validate, format, minify, schema and YAML

description: Everything about one JSON document in a single call: valid or not with the error's line and column, pretty-printed (optionally with sorted keys), minified with the bytes saved, an inferred JSON Schema, structure statistics (depth, objects, arrays, keys, value types) and the same data as YAML. Up to 200 KB. Cheaper than the separate JSON tools. Use to inspect API responses, clean model output or document a payload. Example: json={"name":"agent","tools":["weather","search"],"active":true,"limits":{"daily":100}}. Price $0.03/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

sortKeys.description: true to sort object keys in the formatted output
